definitions.consecutive_run: Exact full bash command string across consecutive tool actions, with tool observations between actions; no command whitespace normalization.
definitions.adjacent_repeat_excess: sum(run_length-1)/all bash actions; distinct from all calls belonging to a repeated run.
definitions.local_context: Same task user-message hash and exact previous2 or4 canonical messages; tool IDs removed and JSON object key order normalized. No semantic embedding/near-duplicate approximation.
definitions.full_prefix: All previous canonical messages+tools, not merely a suffix.
definitions.readonly: Conservative syntax heuristic only; all other commands unknown, not necessarily writes.
definitions.source_success: Publisher resolved label, not independently rerun or verified here.
